model: VideoMAE V2 ViT-S/16, distilled from ViT-g, fine-tuned on Kinetics-710 (vit_s_k710_dl_from_giant)
paper: Wang et al., VideoMAE V2: Scaling Video Masked Autoencoders with Dual Masking, CVPR 2023
license: apache-2.0 (Hugging Face repo card OpenGVLab/VideoMAE2); 上游代码仓库 OpenGVLab/VideoMAEv2 许可证需在报告前再次核对
pretraining_data: UnlabeledHybrid(自监督) + Kinetics-710 有标签微调；通用公开数据，不含 CUHK-X
adaptation: patch_embed 3->4通道（RGB权重x0.75，IR通道取均值x0.75）；去掉710类头，新建40类线性头
